## 5. Risk notes

1. **AFS timing is the bid-killer risk** (GATE-MBD5): unaudited AFS cannot
   be fixed inside a bid window. Go/no-go checkpoint 2026-08-28.
2. Labour-intensive (EPWP-style) competencies required for management and
   supervisory personnel — fold into A9 Details of Key Personnel; no SDK
   fixture covers this quirk.
3. The pack is CIDB-format with municipal MBD forms: complete the OFFICIAL
   issued forms; use both generated packs (MBD + CIDB overlay) as
   transcription worksheets, never as substitutes (KILL-13).
4. One-extra-copy disqualification is unusual and explicit — assign a named
   owner to copy collation (KILL-16).
5. R50m ceiling: price above R50m flips the system to 90/10 and likely
   breaches the envelope — keep the tender sum under the ceiling.
